channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Aaron Gordon | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Aaron Gordon from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Trevon Brazile on Aaron Gordon
item.description:
Trevon Brazile:

“Aaron Gordon plays the four spot, so, you know, I got a lot of questions for him,offensively and defensively. So, you know, he’s kept me up to speed with everything.”

Trevon Brazile on Aaron Gordon, Oct 4, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: David Adelman on Aaron Gordon
item.description:
‪Michael Scotto‬:David Adelman on Aaron Gordon:

“There was no minutes restriction, but I think everybody saw Aaron was laboring. He gave us what he could give us. I thought it was unfair for me to keep him out there, to be honest. We’re going to have to decide what we’re going to do for Game 5.”

David Adelman on Aaron Gordon, Apr 26, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: David Adelman on Aaron Gordon
item.description:
Bennett Durando:David Adelman on Aaron Gordon’s defense:

“Part of the reason why we were switching a lot early, even though sometimes it didn’t go well with Wemby, it’s because you’ve gotta give Aaron the full-throttle fourth quarter. He’s gotta be able to play with fouls and play aggressively.”

David Adelman on Aaron Gordon, Apr 4, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Porter Jr. on Aaron Gordon, Peyton Watson
item.description:
“I'm going to say my prediction is that if everyone gets healthy on the Nuggets — Peyton Watson broke out this year and Aaron Gordon is a difference maker — once they get healthy for the playoffs, it's going to be really, really hard to beat them in seven games,”

Porter Jr. on Aaron Gordon, Peyton Watson, Mar 9, 2026. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: David Adelman on Aaron Gordon
item.description:
David Adelman on resting Aaron Gordon in the second preseason game:

“I think Aaron, Jamal, guys that have had those minor lingering injuries (in the past), we have to get ahead of that. So it just felt like the right time for him to take a two-day break, and now he's back at it.”

David Adelman on Aaron Gordon, Oct 10, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Jonas Valanciunas, Aaron Gordon
item.description:
Nikola Jokic on potentially playing double-big with Jonas Valanciunas (asked and answered as Aaron Gordon was walking by):

“Why not? I’m sick of AG. I cannot play with him anymore. So we need to change him. We’re not gonna change me.”

Nikola Jokic on Jonas Valanciunas, Aaron Gordon, Sep 30, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Michael Porter Jr on Aaron Gordon
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Michael Porter Jr. on last year's playoff run:

“At that point I probably was 20 percent. I was barely able to lift my shoulder and Aaron Gordon had something going on with his calf or hamstring. We were debilitated. I think everything happens for a reason”

Michael Porter Jr on Aaron Gordon, Sep 23, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: David Adelman on Aaron Gordon, Nikola Jokic, Jamal Murray
item.description:
David Adelman:

“Yeah, I mean it was a lot of conversations with Ben and John and Josh. I think we were trying to find pieces that fit — not just names that people knew. We feel like all these guys do complement the group that’s been here, the group that’s accomplished so much over all these years in Denver. And I can tell you right now just from my messaging with Aaron Gordon, Jamal Murray, Nikola Jokic — those guys are excited. And that brings something new for us. They feel like a new gym is going to be there. And for those guys who have been around for so long, sometimes you need that. You need a little bit of change, and this change is a good change.”

David Adelman on Aaron Gordon, Nikola Jokic, Jamal Murray, Jul 16, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: David Adelman on Aaron Gordon
item.description:
David Adelman on Aaron Gordon's availability and effort in Game 7:

“Aaron Gordon is incredible. What he played with today, I don’t know many people that would even attempt to run up and down. ... It’s one of the more incredible things I’ve ever seen.”

David Adelman on Aaron Gordon, May 18, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: David Adelman on Aaron Gordon
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:David Adelman on Aaron Gordon’s Game 7 status:

“If Aaron can go, he’ll go. That’s who he is. There’s a real toughness there. Sometimes being really, really tough and being hurt can get in the way.”

David Adelman on Aaron Gordon, May 18, 2025. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Chet Holmgren on Aaron Gordon
item.description:
Chet Holmgren on Aaron Gordon saying they get away with fouls:

“I feel like when we foul, we’ve been called for fouls. When they foul, they’ve been called for foul…It’s a physical game of basketball. That’s what the playoffs are.”

Chet Holmgren on Aaron Gordon, May 9, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Alex Caruso on Aaron Gordon
item.description:
The decision ensured the Nuggets couldn’t attempt a game-tying 3, but only 0.4 seconds ticked off the game clock when Caruso delivered the foul.

“I probably could have let Gordon dribble a couple of more times, run some more time off the clock,”

Alex Caruso on Aaron Gordon, May 6, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Aaron Gordon, James Harden
item.description:
Law Murray:Tyronn Lue on James Harden foul trouble:

“He's down under the basket wrestling with Gordon the whole game. That's gonna happen. So we just gotta be smart about it, and maybe mix those matchups up a little bit more so he's not on him for the whole game.”

Tyronn Lue on Aaron Gordon, James Harden, Apr 20, 2025. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: Michael Malone on Russell Westbrook, Aaron Gordon
item.description:
Ryan Blackburn:Michael Malone on starting Russell Westbrook last night and if that's a permanent move without Aaron Gordon:

“We'll see. It's not written in stone... Russ has been great for us as a starter.”

Michael Malone on Russell Westbrook, Aaron Gordon, Dec 28, 2024. Source: Twitter @NBABlackburn.

item.title: DaRon Holmes on Al Horford, Draymond Green, Aaron Gordon, Nikola Jokic, Naz Reid
item.description:
DaRon Holmes:

“I like guys like Naz Reid, Al Horford, Nikola Jokic and Aaron Gordon. I take different things from different guys. Defensively, Draymond Green because he’s not the biggest, fastest, or strongest, but he’s smart. He knows how to play in pick-and-roll coverage and uses his mouth to be vocal.”

DaRon Holmes on Al Horford, Draymond Green, Aaron Gordon, Nikola Jokic, Naz Reid, May 21, 2024. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Rudy Gobert on Kobe Bryant, Aaron Gordon
item.description:
Dave McMenamin:Rudy Gobert on Aaron Gordon going 11-for-12:

“A lot of them were contested so if Gordon turns into Kobe Bryant, we just got to live with that”

Rudy Gobert on Kobe Bryant, Aaron Gordon, May 12, 2024. Source: Twitter @mcten.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Aaron Gordon
item.description:
Nikola Jokic on what player he would trust with his horses:

“Aaron Gordon. Because he drives a bike and he was in my hometown, so he kind of saw how it happens, how it looks.”

Nikola Jokic on Aaron Gordon, Feb 17, 2024. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Michael Malone on Aaron Gordon
item.description:
Michael Malone on a timetable for Aaron Gordon to return:

“Right now it’s open ended. We need him to heal inside and out….That’s something where you have to heal from the physical, but you also have to heal from the mental and what you just went through.”

Michael Malone on Aaron Gordon, Dec 27, 2023. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Michael Malone on Aaron Gordon
item.description:
Michael Malone:

“We want him back. We know we're better off with him, but I want to support Aaron Gordon and make sure when he comes back, he's ready to come back and play at the level he's capable of.”

Michael Malone on Aaron Gordon, Dec 27, 2023. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Michael Malone on Aaron Gordon, Karl-Anthony Towns
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Michael Malone:

“All series, Aaron Gordon, his defense on Karl-Anthony Towns. I can't leave this press conference without giving Aaron a lot of love and respectfor the defense he played.”

Michael Malone on Aaron Gordon, Karl-Anthony Towns, Apr 26, 2023. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Tim Connelly on Aaron Gordon
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Tim Connelly:

“Aaron (Gordon) should have been an All-Star. He was amazing this year. You’re seeing four of he best bigs in the league tonight.”

Tim Connelly on Aaron Gordon, Apr 16, 2023. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Bones Hyland on Aaron Gordon
item.description:
HoopsHype: Bones Hyland on if Aaron Gordon should be an All-Star:

“He does the junkyard work for us and I feel like he doesn’t get a lot of praise. So definitely AG an All-Star for sure.”

Bones Hyland on Aaron Gordon, Jan 2, 2023. Source: Twitter @hoopshype.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Aaron Gordon, Monte Morris, Klay Thompson
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Steve Kerr on Klay Thompson:

“His defense is really good. ... He can guard anyone from Monte Morris to Aaron Gordon.... He's made some big plays for us besides just hitting shots.”

Steve Kerr on Aaron Gordon, Monte Morris, Klay Thompson, Apr 24, 2022. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Will Barton, Aaron Gordon, Monte Morris
item.description:
Not only is he on track to become the first player in league history to average at least 25 points, 13 rebounds and six assists per game, but also he’s making his teammates better along the way.

“I think the beauty of basketball is there is always someone who is going to step up — Monte (Morris), AG (Aaron Gordon), Will Barton,”

Nikola Jokic on Will Barton, Aaron Gordon, Monte Morris, Feb 28, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Michael Malone on Aaron Gordon
item.description:
Ryan Blackburn:Michael Malone on Aaron Gordon:

“I think he’s an All-NBA defensive player... I don’t care which game you look at. Aaron Gordon’s defensive presence and effectiveness has been outstanding.”

Michael Malone on Aaron Gordon, Nov 12, 2021. Source: Twitter @NBABlackburn.

item.title: Monte Morris on Aaron Gordon
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Monte Morris on Aaron Gordon:

“In the locker room he’s like, 'These are the easiest baskets I’ve gotten in my whole career.'”

Monte Morris on Aaron Gordon, Apr 5, 2021. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Will Barton on Aaron Gordon
item.description:
But it’s what he gives them on the defensive end that has the Nuggets riding high.

“(Gordon) put everybody back in their place where now I can guard my natural position at the two, instead of going into a lot of games undersized at the three,”

Will Barton on Aaron Gordon, Apr 5, 2021. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Michael Malone on Aaron Gordon
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Malone on how quickly the new starting lineup has gelled:

“I think you have to give Aaron Gordon a tremendous amount of credit...he's come here trying to fit in. I think he realized I'm coming to a really good basketball team.”

Michael Malone on Aaron Gordon, Apr 4, 2021. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Michael Malone on Aaron Gordon
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Malone on Aaron Gordon's offensive role:

“I want him to go out there and play his game while also understanding that we are a ball movement player,movement team that's at its best when the ball and bodies are moving and the ball is not being held and the ball is not sticking.”

Michael Malone on Aaron Gordon, Mar 28, 2021. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Bruce Brown on Aaron Gordon
item.description:
Bruce Brown:

“Teams got to be perfect to beat us and they were just hitting shots - tough shots. I've never seen Aaron Gordon hit shots like that in my life. So just a tough night.”

Bruce Brown on Aaron Gordon, Mar 20, 2021. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.
